_comment: Fill this in after running `--mode inspect` and reading results/inspect/<slug>_network.json in your browser's Network tab. If a location's availability calendar is backed by a plain JSON XHR/fetch call, add an entry here so `--mode api` can hit it directly instead of driving a full browser (faster, more stable, and gentler on the site). Leave a slug out (or set url to null) to fall back to --mode browser for it.
